title: BA1/155/2015 of Ram Awtar Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
BA1 No.155 of 2015
Honíble U.C. Dhyani, J.
 Mr. D.N. Sharma, Advocate for the
applicant.
 Mr. H.S. Rawal, learned Assistant
Government Advocate for the State of
Uttarakhand.
 The applicant seeks bail in connection
with F.I.R. No.157 of 2014, under Section
379, 411, 420, 467 & 468 I.P.C. and 41/102
Cr.P.C., Police Station Gadarpur, District
Udham Singh Nagar.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties,
considered the grounds taken in the bail
application and perused the documents on
record.
 An F.I.R. was lodged by the informant
against six named accused, including the
present applicant for the offences
punishable under Sections 379, 411, 420,
467 & 468 I.P.C. and 41/102 Cr.P.C.,
alleging therein that they were found in
possession of stolen vehicles, which were
being used with fake number plates and
forged papers.
 The applicant is not a previous convict
and is in judicial custody since 30.09.2014.
 Learned counsel for the applicant
stated that the applicant is ready to furnish
reliable sureties to the satisfaction of the
court concerned, if he is directed to be
released on bail.
 Considering the facts of the case,
nature of offences and attenuating
circumstances, a case of bail is made out in
favour of the applicant.
 The bail application is allowed. Let the
accused-applicant be released on bail on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing
two reliable sureties, each of the like
amount to the satisfaction of the Magistrate
concerned.
